title: Retirement Cap by Length of the Seller Performance Standing Record
content:
**Cap.** The retirement cap is the long-tenure retirement cap of 3 points for a standing record opened 1,095 days or more before the closing date, and the mid-tenure retirement cap of 2 points for a record opened at least 730 but fewer than 1,095 days before. A record opened fewer than 730 days before the closing date takes neither of these caps.

This cap limits the points retired when a seller closes the selling account under Seller Performance Standing. The days run from the opening date of the seller's standing record to the closing date.

| Days from the opening of the standing record to the closing date | Retirement cap |
|---|---|
| 1,095 or more | 3 points |
| 730 to 1,094 | 2 points |
| fewer than 730 | neither cap above |

## Boundary readings

- Exactly 1,095 days: 3 points. One day fewer, 1,094 days: 2 points.
- Exactly 730 days: 2 points. One day fewer, 729 days: neither cap above.

**Hypothetical application.** Retired points of 4 are limited to 3 on a record opened 1,500 days before closing, and to 2 on a record opened 800 days before.
